clue.text: Script arriving — it's simple for one to apprehend

parts.note: AR is a timetable abbreviation for arrives or arriving

indicators.note: to apprehend is to seize or hold, so one piece takes the other inside it

parts.note: something easy is said to be as easy as ABC
the Roman numeral for one is I

explanation.surface: Someone learning a script is told it will be easy to pick up.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is only a link word; 'to apprehend' tells ABC to close round the I.
explanation.definitionFit: Arabic is the writing system of the Arabic language, so it is one kind of script.

indicators.note: to upstage is to step in front of another performer, so the U moves forward a place
in a down clue, up means the letters are read from the bottom, so the run is turned round

parts.note: ever means always, as in for ever

explanation.surface: A university production is always stealing the limelight with satire on current affairs.
explanation.walkthrough: U plus EVER, read upwards, gives REVEU; the U then 'up-stages' the E beside it by moving in front, giving the show.
explanation.definitionFit: A revue is a light entertainment of sketches and songs, often satirising current events.

clue.text: Flier's request for seconds in curry house?

definitions.note: the 's stands for is: the flier is a Baltimore oriole, a North American bird

parts.note: a balti is a curry dish, and a balti house is a British curry restaurant
asking for a second helping is asking for more

explanation.surface: A diner in an Indian restaurant asks for another helping.
explanation.walkthrough: The bird is the Baltimore oriole (or the Baltimore checkerspot butterfly); the wordplay reads as 'Balti? More!'.
explanation.definitionFit: The Baltimore oriole is a songbird, so it is a creature that flies.

clue.text: Put ID cards in circulation: lover's shot

indicators.note: things in circulation are moving round, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Fake identity cards are being passed around, a lover's ploy perhaps.
explanation.definitionFit: Cupid, the Roman god of love, fires arrows that make people fall in love, so his dart is a shot of love.

parts.note: the beast in the fairy tale is a ..., and Beauty loves him for the ... ..., playing on the phrase for life's simple pleasures

explanation.surface: A question about the fairy tale Beauty and the Beast.
explanation.walkthrough: The phrase for small physical luxuries like food and warmth is reread as the comforts a monster provides.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means the simple bodily pleasures of life, and reread it means the solace a beast gives.

clue.text: Inventor cast out crap acts in a rage

indicators.note: something in a rage is wild and violent, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A furious critic expels a string of dreadful stage acts.
explanation.definitionFit: Caractacus Potts is the eccentric inventor in Chitty Chitty Bang Bang.

indicators.note: in a down clue, scaling means climbing, so the letters are read from bottom to top
one word sits inside the other

parts.note: tone is the mood or feeling of something
pert means lively and jaunty

explanation.surface: Someone in a cheerful mood climbs over a storehouse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Scaling' means climbing, which in a down clue reads the assembled TOPERTNE from the bottom upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: An entrepot is a depot or trading port where goods are stored for re-export.

definitions.meaning: a performer's rendition or delivery of a piece of music or a speech
the first layer of plaster or cement applied to a wall

explanation.surface: A painter asks whether the first layer of paint has arrived.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a performance or rendition and the base coat of plaster put on a wall.

parts.note: a wicked spirit is a demon, and spirits are strong alcoholic drinks, so the demon drink is a bad liquor

explanation.surface: A temperance-style phrase blaming alcohol for ruin.
explanation.definitionFit: A malign supernatural being is a demon, and spirit doubles as a word for strong liquor.

indicators.note: the answer is made of letters taken from the next two words

explanation.surface: A collection of town districts, as in local government.
explanation.definitionFit: A band is a group, whether of musicians or of people united for a purpose.

clue.text: He and I are prominent members of this organisation

definitions.text: He and I are prominent members of this organisation

parts.words: He and I are prominent members of this organisation
parts.note: He is the symbol for helium and I for iodine, so both are members of the chart that organises the chemical elements

explanation.surface: Two people boast of their standing in some club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He' and 'I' look like pronouns but are chemical symbols.
explanation.definitionFit: The chart of elements arranges helium, iodine and all the others by atomic number.

clue.text: Reduction of output? Not good week for European capital

indicators.note: not means without, so these letters are taken away

parts.note: a go-slow is industrial action in which workers deliberately cut output

explanation.surface: Talk of falling production and a bad week for a capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: A go-slow is British industrial action where workers deliberately work slowly.
explanation.definitionFit: Oslo is the capital city of Norway.

clue.text: Catch thief in well and torture using rope

indicators.note: the first two pieces go inside the third

parts.note: so can mean well, as in 'so, what now?'
to trap is to catch
a pad is a footpad, an old word for a robber on foot

explanation.surface: A thief caught down a well is tortured with a rope.
explanation.definitionFit: The strappado was a torture in which the victim was hoisted by a rope tied to the wrists and dropped.

clue.text: Unwanted falling-out with one having to run anti-crime organisation

parts.note: A is the indefinite article meaning one
to lope is to run with a long easy stride
the CIA is the US Central Intelligence Agency, an agency set against wrongdoers

explanation.surface: A quarrel arises when someone has to head a crime-fighting body.
explanation.walkthrough: 'falling-out' looks like a quarrel but means hair coming out.
explanation.definitionFit: Alopecia is hair loss, which most people would rather not have.

clue.text: Heights: I described length = itself divided by breadth

indicators.note: the letter splits the run into two parts, sitting between them

parts.note: an ell is an old measure of length
an equals sign is read as is
the same piece again, the length

explanation.surface: Reads like a geometry formula about height, length and breadth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heights' is Wuthering Heights, and the definition speaks as its author describing it.
explanation.definitionFit: Ellis Bell was the pen name under which Emily Bronte published Wuthering Heights.

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: Cinna was one of the conspirators who killed Julius Caesar
a bar is a counter where drinks are served

explanation.surface: A plotter has got hold of a red pigment sold over the counter.
explanation.definitionFit: Cinnabar is mercury sulphide, the mineral source of the bright red pigment called vermilion.

clue.text: Church seat that's attached to one spotted entering assurance company

indicators.note: the pieces go into the company's name

parts.note: the Pru is the familiar name of the Prudential, a British assurance company
ie, id est, means that is
a die has spots on its faces

explanation.surface: A church pew linked to someone seen joining an insurance firm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'attached to' joins the two inserted pieces; the Pru is the Prudential, a well-known British insurer.
explanation.definitionFit: A prie-dieu is a kneeling desk for prayer, with a ledge for a book, used in churches.

parts.note: legs support a body or a table
a football or cricket side has eleven players

explanation.surface: A doctor's visit propped up by the team's support.
explanation.walkthrough: House is the British name for the game bingo; caller's call for the number 11 is this phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: In bingo, called house or housey-housey in Britain, the number 11 is announced with this rhyme.

clue.text: Answer: 'What shall I use for distillation?'

definitions.text: What shall I use for distillation?
definitions.meaning: a glass vessel with a long bent neck used for distilling

explanation.surface: A chemist asks what equipment to use for distilling.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a sharp reply and a long-necked laboratory vessel for distilling.

clue.text: DNA analysis should enable child in suit to back ancestor

indicators.note: to back means to go backwards, so the phrase is read from end to start

parts.words: DNA analysis should enable child in suit
parts.note: in a paternity suit a DNA test lets the child name pa, the father

explanation.surface: A genetic test helps a child in a paternity case trace a forebear.
explanation.walkthrough: The words imagine a paternity case, where DNA lets the child NAME PA; read backwards that gives the forebear.
explanation.definitionFit: Early hominids are thought of as human ancestors, half ape and half human.

indicators.note: in a down clue, on means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: mot is French for word, used in English as in bon mot
If is the famous poem by Rudyard Kipling

explanation.surface: A word about the theme of a poem.
explanation.definitionFit: A motif is a recurring idea or theme in a work of art.

clue.text: Iron crate has room for critics

parts.note: to press clothes is to iron them
a crate is a box

explanation.surface: A box holding an iron with space for complaints.
explanation.definitionFit: The press box is the area at a stadium or theatre set aside for journalists and reviewers.

indicators.note: talked about means spoken, so the letters are what the words sound like

parts.note: of Yule, Yule being Christmas, said quickly

explanation.surface: An egg discussed in connection with a holy feast like Easter.
explanation.definitionFit: An ovule is the structure in a plant that becomes a seed, a small egg cell.

clue.text: Uncommunicative one so ready to act unfortunately put on debut

indicators.note: things gone wrong are jumbled, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A reserved actor, keen to perform, is let down by a poor first night.
explanation.walkthrough: 'one so ready to act' adds a second sense: dressed and buttoned up, ready to go.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone tight-lipped and reserved is said to be all fastened up, giving nothing away.

definitions.meaning: a bank clerk who counts money
a narrator, one who recounts a story

explanation.surface: A counter-rebuttal in some argument.
explanation.definitionFit: A bank cashier counts cash and a storyteller tells, so both are one who tells.
